differences.title: 1. CORE IMPLEMENTATION
differences.leftDesc: Turbopack leverages Rust for performance-critical operations, offering near-instant builds and updates due to its compiled nature and efficient memory management.
differences.rightDesc: Vite is built with ViteScript (a custom superset of JavaScript) and leverages Rollup for production builds, providing a mature and widely compatible ecosystem.

differences.title: 2. MODULE RESOLUTION
differences.leftDesc: Turbopack aims for native ESM support but also handles CommonJS seamlessly, integrating deeply with Node.js module semantics for broad compatibility.
differences.rightDesc: Vite uses native ES Modules during development, avoiding bundlers for faster cold starts. It leverages Rollup for production bundling to handle CJS.

differences.title: 3. COMPILATION STRATEGY
differences.leftDesc: Turbopack employs an aggressive incremental compilation strategy, caching intermediate outputs to rebuild only changed parts of the dependency graph extremely quickly.
differences.rightDesc: Vite uses esbuild for pre-bundling dependencies and Vite's own plugin API for transformation. Production builds use Rollup, offering a rich plugin ecosystem.

differences.title: 4. DEVELOPMENT SERVER
differences.leftDesc: Turbopack prioritizes extremely fast cold starts, even for large projects, by optimizing the initial build process and enabling rapid subsequent updates.
differences.rightDesc: Vite's development server leverages native ES Modules and esbuild for instant cold starts and Hot Module Replacement (HMR), leading to a very fast dev experience.

differences.title: 5. PERFORMANCE FOCUS
differences.leftDesc: Turbopack is designed as a complete, high-performance build toolchain from development to production, aiming to replace existing bundlers and compilers.
differences.rightDesc: Vite excels as a development server with rapid feedback loops. Its production build relies on Rollup, a mature and highly configurable bundler.

differences.title: 6. ECOSYSTEM INTEGRATION
differences.leftDesc: Turbopack is newer, actively building its plugin system and integrations. It aims to be compatible with existing bundler configurations where possible.
differences.rightDesc: Vite leverages the vast JavaScript ecosystem and has a rich plugin API, integrating seamlessly with tools like React, Vue, and Svelte.

differences.title: 7. USE CASE SCENARIO
differences.leftDesc: Turbopack's performance optimizations and Rust core make it particularly well-suited for very large codebases and demanding build processes.
differences.rightDesc: Vite is an excellent choice for modern web applications, offering a smooth and fast development experience with easy configuration.
